2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch adds a new callback function called ->iomap_next() to the iomap API, which replaces the existing ->iomap_begin() and ->iomap_end() callbacks. The new function is responsible for finishing the previous mapping if needed and producing the next mapping. This change allows performance-critical callers to inline their iteration loop and pass their ->iomap_next() function as a compile-time constant, enabling devirtualization of the callback into a direct call. The patch also updates the iomap_iter() function to use the new ->iomap_next() callback when available, falling back to the old path if not. This change is intended to improve performance and make it easier for filesystems to be converted to use the new API.
